name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without sacrificing screen space or visual clutter. The 7:1 contrast meets WCAG AAA for users with low vision, while the 4px width balances visibility and subtlety. Trade-off: thicker rings may feel heavy on dense screens, but clarity outweighs minimal aesthetic impact.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring at 7:1 contrast fails when users toggle *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast mode—it becomes a flickering distraction. Better alternative: Use a 3px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a subtle 1px outer glow that survives both modes. Settle it by testing with a screen reader user who toggles both settings.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow at 7:1 contrast. This survives reduced motion and high contrast mode without flickering or visual noise. The 4.5:1 ring meets WCAG AA for most users while the glow ensures visibility in extreme cases. Trade-off: the glow adds a slight aesthetic flourish, but it’s necessary for reliability across modes.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 1px outer glow at 7:1 contrast risks blending into the background on dark themes or low-contrast surfaces, creating a "halo" that fails on some displays. Better alternative: Use a 2px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px inset shadow at 7:1—this survives both modes without blooming. Settle it by testing with a screen reader user who toggles both modes on a mid-tier Android device in sunlight.
